info.name: Vetspire GraphQL API
info.description: GraphQL operations for the Vetspire veterinary practice management platform. All requests are HTTP POST to https://api.vetspire.com/graphql with an Authorization API token. Grouped by documented domain. Representative queries grounded in developer.vetspire.com; confirm exact fields via live introspection. Max query depth is 8.

data.query: query SearchClients($searchTerm: String!) { clients(searchTerm: $searchTerm) { id givenName familyName email phoneNumber balance patients { id name species } } }

items.docs: Search and list clients (pet owners) in the Accounts domain.

data.query: query GetPatient($id: ID!) { patient(id: $id) { id name species breed sex status birthDate client { id givenName familyName } } }

items.docs: Retrieve a patient (animal) by ID from the Clinical domain.

data.query: query LocationAppointments($locationId: ID!, $start: DateTime!, $end: DateTime!) { appointments(locationId: $locationId, start: $start, end: $end) { id start end type status patient { id name } provider { id name } } }

items.docs: List appointments for a location and date range (Schedule domain).

data.query: query PatientEncounters($patientId: ID!) { encounters(patientId: $patientId) { id status date assessment plan provider { id name } } }

items.docs: List clinical encounters (visits) for a patient.

data.query: query ClientInvoices($clientId: ID!) { invoices(clientId: $clientId) { id number status total balance lineItems { description quantity unitPrice total } } }

items.docs: List invoices for a client (Billing / New Billing domains).

data.query: query SearchProducts($searchTerm: String!) { products(searchTerm: $searchTerm) { id name code price quantityOnHand } }

items.docs: Search products in the Inventory domain.

data.query: query Locations { locations { id name timezone providers { id name } } }

items.docs: List locations and their providers (Hospital domain).

data.query: query PatientReminders($patientId: ID!) { reminders(patientId: $patientId) { id name status dueDate } }

items.docs: List due/overdue reminders for a patient (Reminders domain).

data.query: query PatientLabOrders($patientId: ID!) { labOrders(patientId: $patientId) { id status name results { analyte value unit referenceRange flag } } }

items.docs: List lab orders and results for a patient (Lab domain).

data.query: mutation SendMessage($input: MessageInput!) { sendMessage(input: $input) { id channel body sentAt } }

items.docs: Send a message to a client (Conversations / Marketing domains).

data.query: query Events($filter: EventFilter) { events(filter: $filter) { id action entityType entityId occurredAt } }

items.docs: Query the platform event log (Events domain) for auditing and sync.
